tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.22.5;
father of: Balaam (H1109A)
Also named: Bosor, Beōr (Βοσόρ, Βεώρ "Beor" G1007)
§ Beor = "burning"
1) father of Balaam
2) father of Bela, king of Edom

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam
strongs_1890.derivation: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of burning); a lamp;
